newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas says it not Gle des Eaux bid target.
newsitem.headline: Havas says it not Gle des Eaux bid target.

text.p: Havas chairman Pierre Dauzier said on Friday he was convinced French conglomerate Generale des Eaux would make no takeover bid for the media group.

"I am certain, at least in the framework of our agreements that run for 10 years at least, that there will be no public takeover offer by Cie Generale des Eaux for Havas," he said in an interview on French radio station France Info.

Generale des Eaux's stake in Havas will rise to 29.6 percent after an agreement to restructure media assets seen by analysts as a first move toward creating a major French player in the European communications sector.
